name: Erdos-Turan swap Frobenius: a finite set B under Z₂ swap action on B×B. The orbit space U holds unordered pairs. The projection μ: B×B → U collapses each ordered pair to its unordered representative. The section δ: U → B×B chooses a canonical ordering. Together they form a Frobenius algebra with μ∘δ = id_U and δ∘μ = (id + Swap)/2. The Sidon property ensures |sumSet| = |U| = k(k+1)/2. The frontier is at Belnap position B — the point where the Sidon bound and the basis demand are numerically identical. The ob3ect proves the bound and halts; weighing the demand against it costs the invariant landing.
